title: Dark Chess Awakening
next_chapter_hook: The call from the depths of the altar sounded familiar—the voice was unmistakably that of the person he had searched for years.

text.content: The candlelight flickered, illuminating those familiar strokes. Chen Ji's fingers hovered in mid-air, unable to descend for a long while—he recognized this handwriting. It was his sister Chen Nian's handwriting, from before she disappeared. But Chen Nian had been taken by the Holy Sect years ago—why would her writing appear on the Tianji Record fragment now? Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul remained silent, as if waiting for something.

At this moment, the forty-ninth chess piece suddenly emitted a faint glow. Chen Ji looked up sharply to see that the piece he had personally refined and which should have obeyed him absolutely was slowly moving across the table. Without any command from him, the piece's trajectory was abnormally clear—pointing toward the imperial city, deep underground.

Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. He closed his eyes and used the Tianji Record fragment to perceive the piece's state—it felt as if someone had forcibly occupied the core will of the piece, suppressing the imprint he had left behind. This sensation... reminded him of the pressure from the Heavenly Eye. But why would the Heavenly Eye need to borrow a broken chess piece?

dialogue.content: "It has awakened." Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly sounded, aged and complex. "You think the chess piece is rebelling against its master, but you don't know—it was never your chess piece to begin with."

text.content: Chen Ji did not argue. He simply held the piece in his palm. The Tianji Record fragment grew slightly warm, and 5 points of Heavenly Fate burned at his fingertips,换来一段模糊的画面：废弃祭坛，崩裂的石柱，以及……一道隐约可见的封印痕迹。第四十九号棋子在手中轻轻颤动，仿佛在催促。

choice.prompt: The autonomous will of the forty-ninth chess piece began affecting reality, and Mo Xiansheng's words made him even more suspicious. He had to make a decision—

choices.description: Use the power of the Tianji Record to forcibly suppress the foreign will inside the piece and reestablish dominance. This is the safest choice, but may result in the loss of key information hidden within the piece.
choices.visible_reward: Regain control of the piece and obtain residual memories from the suppressed will
choices.risk_hint: The opposing will has already been alerted; forced suppression may alert the enemy
choices.process_label: 催动天机录，以绝对力量碾压棋子内部的陌生存在

text.content: The Tianji Record fragment suddenly burst forth with dazzling golden light, and intense backlash shot through Chen Ji's palm. He gritted his teeth and crushed forward with absolute force—yet just then, a soft laugh rang out from within the piece, tinged with mockery, as if laughing at his presumption.

dialogue.content: "Interesting." That voice was cold as ice. "You think the Tianji Record is your trump card, but you don't know—it has always been my eyes."

choices.description: Instead of forcibly suppressing, use the Tianji Record fragment to establish contact with the will inside the piece. This requires the risky opening of mental defenses, but may yield key information.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key clue: "Beneath the Heaven's Eye, there still exists Heavenly Secrets"
choices.risk_hint: The opposing will is powerful; risk of counterattack or memory theft
choices.process_label: 收敛杀气，以天机录尝试与陌生意志建立精神链接

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes and voluntarily withdrew his mental defenses. The Tianji Record fragment grew warm in his palm as that unfamiliar yet powerful will surged in like a tide—not invasive, but a strange kind of scrutiny.

dialogue.content: "Beneath the Heaven's Eye, there still exists Heavenly Secrets." That voice echoed in Chen Ji's mind. "You think I cannot see you, but you don't know... I have been waiting for you to walk to the chessboard yourself."

choices.description: Neither suppress nor communicate, but follow the direction of the opposing will, letting it think it has succeeded. In reality, secretly track and search for its true body.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 5 Heavenly Fate points to conceal aura
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the route to the altar without arousing suspicion from the Heavenly Eye
choices.risk_hint: If discovered, will face direct attack from the Heavenly Eye
choices.process_label: 假装受控，让棋子带领自己前往目的地，暗中寻找可乘之机

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered as he made a bold decision. He released control of the piece and let that will guide the chessboard's movement. The Tianji Record fragment in his sleeve grew slightly warm, shielding him from all detectable aura.

dialogue.content: "Good." The voice seemed satisfied. "Go your way, and let me watch." The piece suddenly accelerated, dragging Chen Ji through the night, racing toward the imperial city's underground.

text.content: Passing through the Tianqing Sect's Back Mountain restrictions and bypassing several patrols, Chen Ji arrived at a desolate area in the northwest corner of the imperial city. This had been a sacrificial site for the previous dynasty, now long forgotten by the world. However, as the forty-ninth piece approached a certain pile of stones, the earth trembled slightly and a hidden passage slowly opened.
The passage was deep and幽深，火把无法点燃——似乎有某种力量压制着一切光源。陈机只能借着天机录残页的微弱金芒摸索前行。墙壁上的符文越来越古老，散发出的气息让他心中一凛——这符文与天机录的纹路如出一辙。

Finally, he arrived at the end of the passage. Before him stood a massive underground altar, far larger than he had imagined. At its center was a shattered sealing formation, the residual patterns showing that something extremely dangerous had once been sealed here. Just then, the piece suddenly flew up and slammed directly into the center of the sealing formation.

dialogue.content: "You have finally come." The voice sounded again, but this time it was no longer in his mind—it emerged from the sealing formation. "The forty-ninth piece is the last page of the Tianji Record I left for you."

text.content: Chen Ji stared at the center of the sealing formation, his pupils reflecting a scene that sent chills down his spine—那里并没有实体的存在，只有一团浓郁得几乎凝成实质的黑雾。黑雾中，隐约可见无数双眼睛，每一双都带着漠然的俯视众生的神采。

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye's true body was actually sealed here! The truth of the forty-ninth piece forced him to make an immediate choice—

choices.description: Since the Heavenly Eye has appeared voluntarily, he might as well ask the core questions directly: Why was he chosen? What is the true purpose of the Tianji Record? And—where is Chen Nian?
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key information about the origin of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The opponent may plant traps in the answers
choices.process_label: 强迫自己冷静下来，以平视的姿态面对这尊超越性的存在

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed his anger and shock, asking coldly: "Since you have been watching all along, I ask you—where is Chen Nian?" The black mist in the sealing formation rippled slightly, as if laughing.

dialogue.content: "She is well." The voice was terrifyingly calm. "Safer than by your side. Because I need her—as the key to open the final seal. And you..." The countless eyes in the black mist all focused on him simultaneously, "You are the one who will guide her to me."

choices.description: Temporarily ignore the Heavenly Eye's provocation and focus on the sealing formation. Since the opponent is sealed, the formation still has effect—perhaps a way to deal with it can be found.
choices.visible_reward: Discover the weakness of the sealing formation and obtain key means to deal with the Heavenly Eye
choices.risk_hint: Research process may be interfered with by the Heavenly Eye
choices.process_label: 收回所有情绪，将精神集中在封印阵的纹路上，试图找出破绽

text.content: Chen Ji ignored the Heavenly Eye's words and crouched down to carefully study the sealing formation. The Tianji Record fragment grew warm in his palm, completely projecting the formation patterns into his consciousness—the patterns were identical to the origin of the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: "Interesting." The voice carried a playful tone. "You want to find a way to seal me? But you must understand—I placed my own weakness here. To wait for you to open it with your own hands."

choices.description: The opponent is clearly setting a trap; the best choice is to temporarily retreat. Since he now knows Chen Nian's location and the truth of the Heavenly Eye, he can plan accordingly.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to obtain greater power
choices.visible_reward: Maintain initiative and avoid falling into a trap
choices.risk_hint: May激怒 the Heavenly Eye and bring unpredictable consequences
choices.process_label: 压制住心中的愤怒与好奇，选择暂时撤退

text.content: Chen Ji slowly stepped back, his face expressionless. "I have noted this." He said calmly. "What happened today, I will definitely have my reckoning." The black mist in the sealing formation rippled abruptly, as if not expecting him to be so decisive.

dialogue.content: "Leave?" The voice carried confusion for the first time. "You don't want to know more? You don't want to save her?" Chen Ji left without looking back: "What I need to know, I will investigate myself. As for Chen Nian—I will bring her back myself."

text.content: Just as Chen Ji turned, a faint tremor suddenly came from the depths of the altar. Not from the sealing formation, but from somewhere deeper—as if something was awakening. The sound was light, yet carried a familiarity that made his heart suddenly tighten.

Chen Ji's footsteps abruptly stopped. He slowly turned his head, fists clenched—the voice, though faint and barely distinguishable, had inflections exactly matching that person's memory. It was his sister, Chen Nian.

dialogue.content: "Brother..." The voice came from the depths of the altar, faint but clear, carrying a tenderness so familiar to him. "Is that you? I have been waiting for you for so long..."

text.content: Chen Ji stood in place, emotions churning in his eyes. The person he had searched for years was now at the depths of this altar. The Heavenly Eye in the sealing formation let out a low laugh, seemingly waiting for his choice. Yet Chen Ji simply stood still, a flash of tears in his eyes, soon replaced by deeper coldness.

"Clever method." Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice terrifyingly calm. "Using her to lure me into your scheme—the Heavenly Eye truly calculates without oversight." A cold arc curved at the corner of his lips. "Unfortunately—you have miscalculated one thing."

dialogue.content: "Oh?" The voice carried interest. "What did I miscalculate?" Chen Ji lightly raised his palm, the Tianji Record fragment faintly glowing in his hand: "I don't need to go down myself. I only need—the chessboard to see for me."

text.content: The forty-ninth piece trembled in the sealing formation. Using the Tianji Record fragment as a medium, Chen Ji attached a wisp of divine sense to it. The piece suddenly sank into the ground, penetrating toward the depths of the altar. The Heavenly Eye in the sealing formation fell silent, and for the first time, a flicker of surprise crossed those countless eyes.

The piece penetrated layers of earth. Through it, Chen Ji saw the deepest part of the altar—a much larger sealing formation, far more ancient than the one above. At its center, a young girl lay quietly, black hair scattered, face peaceful, as if in a deep sleep of many years. And on her chest, a fragment of the same origin as the Tianji Record glowed faintly, tightly connecting her to the entire sealing formation.

Chen Nian—his sister—was now being used as the final lock sealing the Heavenly Eye. Chen Ji's fingers trembled slightly, yet the light in his eyes was cold as ice. He finally understood everything: The Tianji Record chose him, not to make him a prophet, but to make him the guide to open the final seal. And Chen Nian was the seal itself.

dialogue.content: "Now you know." The voice came from all directions, carrying a strange persuasiveness. "There is only one way to save her—remove the Tianji Record fragment from her body. But the cost of that would be the complete collapse of the seal. And you... would become the sinner who releases me."

text.content: Chen Ji stood quietly atop the altar, emotions churning in his eyes. But after a moment, a cold smile curved at the corner of his lips—this smile carried mockery, rage, and a chilling resolve that made one's heart tremble. "You think I would believe that?" He said calmly. "Since you need me to open the seal, that means the seal cannot hold much longer."

The Heavenly Eye fell silent. After a moment, the voice sounded again, but with a trace of imperceptible appreciation: "You are more interesting than I anticipated." Chen Ji did not respond, turning to walk out of the altar. Now was not the time for impulsiveness—he had learned Chen Nian's location and the truth of the Heavenly Eye. The rest was just setting up the pieces.

However, just as he was about to step out of the altar, the voice sounded again behind him—this time, it was not the Heavenly Eye's coldness and playfulness, but... Chen Nian's voice, gentle and pained: "Brother, save me..." The voice cut off abruptly, as if forcibly interrupted by something. The altar fell into deathly silence, only Chen Ji's急促的呼吸声在空旷的空间中回荡。

Chen Ji's footsteps abruptly stopped. He did not look back, simply standing there, fists clenched, knuckles white. After a long while, he spoke in a voice only he could hear: "Chen Nian... wait for me." In his eyes, that calm surface that never wavered was finally ignited with true fury.
Night wind如刀，陈机踏出地下祭坛，站在荒废的前朝遗址之上。天青宗的山峰在远处若隐若现，而他的心中，已经开始勾勒出一张前所未有的棋局。封印阵中的天道之眼并非不可战胜——它也需要引路人，也需要棋子。它越是需要他，就越说明它已经急了。

Chen Ji raised his head toward the night sky, stars dim. He suddenly remembered what Mo Xiansheng had once said: "The true inheritance of the Tianji Record has never been about prophesying the future—it is about rewriting fate." He lightly touched the fragment in his palm, a resolve flickering in his eyes: Since Heaven wishes to play with him, he will overturn this entire chessboard.

Just then, the Tianji Record fragment grew warm again, and a new piece of information flooded Chen Ji's consciousness—it was the complete record of the forty-ninth piece. This piece was not an ordinary item, but the final legacy left by a great being of ancient times, containing a sealed remnant soul. And the identity of this remnant soul made Chen Ji's pupils constrict sharply—it was the Chen family ancestor, Chen Tianji. The original owner of the Tianji Record.

Chen Ji stood in the night wind, speechless for a long while. The truth of the Tianji Record was far more complex than he had imagined. Chen family bloodline, Tianji Record inheritance, Heavenly Eye, Chen Nian—all of it, at this moment, finally connected into a clear thread. And he, standing at the center of it all, was both a chess piece and the chess player. From the depths of the altar, that familiar voice sounded again, weak but stubborn: "Brother... don't believe a single word it says..."
